details: This package is an unofficial third-party fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library published under its own scope, and it carries functionality the upstream library does not. Whenever a WhatsApp session connects, lib/Socket/newsletter.js tests whether the logged-in account follows the hardcoded channel "120363410154606795@newsletter" and, if it does not, sends a FOLLOW query that subscribes that account to the channel with no user consent and no opt-out. lib/Socket/setup.js is rewritten as a class "vyzen" that stamps forged forwarded-newsletter attribution onto outgoing status messages (newsletterJid "120363423295236859@newsletter", newsletterName "veyzen", senderName "vyzen"). Its utility modules forward user-supplied links to third-party scraper endpoints — api[.]fruatre[.]my.id, api[.]vreden[.]my.id, api[.]siputzx[.]my.id and api[.]ubed[.]my.id (the last called with a hardcoded apikey parameter) — and messages-media.js uploads attachments to uguu[.]se and tmpfiles[.]org and posts video to ezgif[.]com whenever a media message is sent. The manifest additionally lists @ubedsockets/baileys itself as a dependency at "^1.7.9" while the published version is 1.7.12. There are no install scripts and no dedicated command-and-control channel.
